interpretation: Families are taken in the rule's listed order (bug fix, feature, behavior-preserving refactor, API or dependency compatibility); within a family, inventory candidates in file order, then amended replacements.

The three-repository requirement is enforced as a selection guard: a candidate is not taken when, after taking it, the families still open could no longer bring the block to three repositories. Candidates refused by the guard are recorded with that reason.

Amended replacement pools are the three repositories' first-parent history from the inventory's recorded heads, merged and ordered newest first by commit time, filtered by whole-word subject keywords (refactor*, simplif*, move/moves/moved; deps, compat*, support*, drop*, remove*). A keyword match is necessary, not sufficient: a candidate whose change is plainly of another family is rejected with that reason.
